title: Practice: Ionic Bonding: The Story of Sodium Chloride
description: Practice questions for Ionic Bonding: The Story of Sodium Chloride.

questions.question: What is transferred in ionic bonding?
questions.explanation: The correct answer is: Electrons. This matches the main idea of Ionic Bonding: The Story of Sodium Chloride.

questions.question: In NaCl, sodium becomes
questions.explanation: The correct answer is: Na⁺. This matches the main idea of Ionic Bonding: The Story of Sodium Chloride.

questions.question: Ionic bonds usually form between
questions.explanation: The correct answer is: metal and nonmetal. This matches the main idea of Ionic Bonding: The Story of Sodium Chloride.

questions.question: What holds Na⁺ and Cl⁻ together?
questions.explanation: The correct answer is: Opposite-charge attraction. This matches the main idea of Ionic Bonding: The Story of Sodium Chloride.

questions.question: True or False: Chlorine gains an electron when NaCl forms.
questions.explanation: This statement is true based on the lesson concepts.

questions.question: True or False: Ionic bonding is equal sharing of electrons.
questions.explanation: This statement is false based on the lesson concepts.

questions.question: An ionic bond is the attraction between oppositely charged ________.
Why do Na⁺ and Cl⁻ attract?
questions.correctAnswer: They have opposite electric charges, and opposite charges attract.
questions.explanation: A complete answer should use the key idea from the lesson and support it with reasoning.
